messages:
akshay: alerting — noticed persistent low-and-slow requests to /v1/embeddings and /v1/stream from many different API keys, ~8k req/min aggregated but each key small. suspicious multiplexing pattern.
sec-bot: [ANOMALY] token-reuse-high, confidence=0.91, src_asns=[AS4538, AS2914, AS13335] — flagged at 2026-03-18T02:13Z.
maria: thx akshay. @ops-oncall can we throttle by key+path first and add JS challenge for suspect ASNs? also want an immediate audit of token issuance in last 48h.
ops-oncall: copying. starting containment: will add an ipset for the ASNs and apply edge drop policy for non-bearer traffic. patching rate-limit per-key to 60 rpm for embeddings endpoints.
ops-oncall: runbook commands I'm pushing now:
```bash
# create ipset and block at edge firewall
ipset create rba_block_1780 hash:net -exist
ipset add rba_block_1780 203.0.113.0/24
# apply temporary edge rule
edgectl waf rule add --name "rba-low-slow-1780" --match "ipset(rba_block_1780)" --action js_challenge
```
maria: good. also: rotate any service tokens that were created without RBAC scopes in the last 72h. tag them as suspicious and revoke if unused. log rotation action to audit logs (KMS access recorded).
ken (cs): heads-up — a couple customers reported higher 429s. do we need a customer notification?
akshay: reply to affected customers with: "temporary rate-limits applied to mitigate abuse; your traffic might see transient 429s — no data exfiltration suspected; we're rotating suspect keys and will follow up with post-incident details." keep short.
sre-bot: deploy bot: rolled out rate-limit config to edge region us-west-2 in 2m.
maria: action items for post-contain: 1) full audit of tokens (who created, scope, last-used), 2) KMS key access logs review for any suspicious decrypt/unwrap events, 3) RBAC hardening: disallow wildcard admin token creation from self-serve, 4) update runbook for multiplex low-and-slow vector.
akshay: I'm collecting token create logs now — will dump list to secure s3 and reference in the incident slack thread.
ops-oncall: added temporary WAF rule with JS challenge + per-key limiter. dropping ASN-based ipset after 24h unless we see more.
maria: plan for KMS: schedule immediate key version rotation for any compromised service key. coordinate with infra-sec for HSM ops window. do NOT rotate customer-managed keys.
ken (cs): drafting customer note to be approved: "We've mitigated an automated probing activity by applying temporary rate limits and additional edge checks. If you see 429s, please let us know. We're reviewing auth tokens and will rotate any internal service tokens as needed."
akshay: putting a short timeline here: detection 02:12Z, containment (rate-limit + js-challenge) 02:20Z, token audit kickoff 02:25Z, KMS audit scheduled 04:00Z.
maria: assign owners: akshay -> token audit + customer comms, ops-oncall -> edge rule maintenance, infra-sec -> KMS access logs + rotation plan, product-security -> RBAC policy change PR.
sre-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2026-1780, linking logs and runbook.
maria: we'll reconvene in 2 hours for status. please add any new findings to the ticket and tag me. :white_check_mark:
